calculators.title: Calculators
calculators.description: Investment, asset, business, loan and tax calculators for quick estimates.
calculators.disclaimer: Calculations are for reference only and are not financial, investment, or tax advice.

compoundInterest.title: Compound interest
compoundInterest.description: Future value of capital with monthly compounding.

futureValueContributions.title: Future value with contributions
futureValueContributions.description: Portfolio growth with regular monthly additions.
futureValueContributions.formula: FV = P * (1 + i)^n + PMT * ((1 + i)^n - 1) / i; when i = 0, FV = P + PMT * n.

goal.title: Goal calculator
goal.description: Monthly amount needed to reach a target.

averagePurchasePrice.title: Average purchase price
averagePurchasePrice.description: Weighted average after an additional buy.

profitLoss.title: Profit / loss
profitLoss.description: P&L for a position after selling.
profitLoss.formula: P&L = quantity * sell price - quantity * buy price - fees.

dividendIncome.title: Dividend income
dividendIncome.formula: Net = shares * dividend per share * payments - tax.

rebalancing.title: Portfolio rebalancing
rebalancing.description: How much to buy or sell to hit target allocation.
rebalancing.formula: Target value = total portfolio value * target percent / 100.

positionValue.title: Position value
positionValue.description: Value of a stock or crypto position.

averageAfterPurchase.title: Average after purchase
averageAfterPurchase.description: New average price after buying more.
averageAfterPurchase.formula: Average = (old quantity * old average + added quantity * added price) / total quantity.

breakEvenPrice.title: Break-even price
breakEvenPrice.description: Price needed to cover purchase and fees.

allocationPercentage.title: Allocation percentage
allocationPercentage.description: Position share in total portfolio value.

riskPositionSize.title: Risk per trade
riskPositionSize.description: Position size from account risk and stop-loss.
riskPositionSize.formula: Quantity = account size * risk percent / abs(entry - stop-loss).

vat.title: VAT / НДС
vat.description: Add or extract VAT with a custom rate.
vat.formula: Add VAT: total = amount * (1 + rate). Extract VAT: base = total / (1 + rate).

marginMarkup.title: Margin and markup
marginMarkup.description: Profitability of selling price versus cost.
marginMarkup.formula: Margin = profit / price * 100. Markup = profit / cost * 100.

revenueProfit.title: Revenue and profit
revenueProfit.description: Profit and margin from revenue and costs.
revenueProfit.formula: Profit = revenue - costs. Margin = profit / revenue * 100.

businessBreakEven.title: Break-even point
businessBreakEven.description: Units and revenue needed to cover fixed costs.
businessBreakEven.formula: Units = fixed costs / (price per unit - variable cost per unit).

payback.title: Payback period
payback.description: Months needed to recover an investment.
payback.formula: Payback = initial investment / monthly cash flow.

annuityPayment.title: Annuity payment
annuityPayment.formula: Payment = P * i * (1 + i)^n / ((1 + i)^n - 1); zero interest uses P / n.

differentiatedPayment.title: Differentiated payment
differentiatedPayment.description: First, last and total payments for differentiated loan.
differentiatedPayment.formula: Monthly principal is fixed; interest is charged on remaining principal.

investmentProfitTax.title: Investment profit tax
investmentProfitTax.description: Simple tax estimate for positive investment profit.

vatTax.title: VAT extraction
vatTax.description: Extract VAT from an amount including VAT.
vatTax.formula: Base = amount / (1 + rate); VAT = amount - base.
